sources.title: MobileViT - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The MobileViT model was proposed in MobileViT: Light-weight, General-purpose, and Mobile-friendly Vision Transformer by Sachin Mehta and Mohammad Rastegari. MobileViT introduces a new layer that replaces local processing in convolutions with global processing using transformers.

sources.title: AlamViT: A Lightweight Spatiotemporal Facial Expression Model for ...
sources.snippet: Automated facial pain recognition could support future monitoring tools for patients who cannot reliably self-report pain. Existing approaches either neglect temporal dynamics by processing single frames or employ computationally demanding models. This paper presents AlamViT, a computationally efficient video model that integrates Swin-style windowed spatial attention into a MobileViT backbone ...

sources.title: [2110.02178] MobileViT: Light-weight, General-purpose, and Mobile ...
sources.snippet: Towards this end, we introduce MobileViT, a light-weight and general-purpose vision transformer for mobile devices. MobileViT presents a different perspective for the global processing of information with transformers, i.e., transformers as convolutions.

sources.title: transformers/docs/source/en/model_doc/mobilevit.md at main ...
sources.snippet: MobileViT MobileViT is a lightweight vision transformer for mobile devices that merges CNN's efficiency and inductive biases with transformers global context modeling. It treats transformers as convolutions, enabling global information processing without the heavy computational cost of standard ViTs.
